DescriptionsMultilanguage.en: Survive while zombies from Parallel Universe No.44 invade from portals
DescriptionsMultilanguage.zh: 在44号平行宇宙的僵尸通过裂缝入侵的情况下存活

Lines.en: Do you know that your excessive exploration of this universe has seriously damaged the nearby space-time structure?
Lines.zh: 知不知道，你们对这个宇宙的过度探索，已经严重破坏了附近的时空结构？

Lines.en: Data shows that the space-time coordinates we are in are very close to another universe, and the surrounding space-time structure has also begun to become unstable.
Lines.zh: 数据显示，我们所处的时空坐标与另一个宇宙十分相近，周围的时空结构也开始变得不稳定。

Lines.en: The conditions for the formation of the space-time rift have already been met.
Lines.zh: 已经满足了时空裂缝生成的条件。

Lines.en: It seems that there are zombies on the other side of the rift as well.
Lines.zh: 貌似裂缝的对面也有僵尸。

Lines.en: Is there a taco over there?
